clauses.title: Section 4. Non-Compete and Non-Solicitation

Section 4. Non-Compete and Non-Solicitation
During employment and for a period of twelve (12) months following termination of employment, Employee shall not directly or indirectly engage in or assist any business that directly competes with Company within a 50-mile geographical radius.

clauses.title: Section 6. Termination Provisions
clauses.original_text:
Section 6. Termination Provisions
Company may terminate Employee employment at any time without cause upon thirty (30) days prior written notice. Company may terminate Employee employment immediately for Cause in the event of gross negligence, fraud, or conviction of a felony.

clauses.title: Section 7. Governing Law and Dispute Resolution
clauses.original_text:
Section 7. Governing Law and Dispute Resolution
This Agreement shall be construed and governed in accordance with the laws of the State of California. Any controversy or dispute arising under this Agreement shall be settled by binding arbitration in San Francisco, California.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the date first above written.
Apex Innovations Corp: Elena Rostova (CEO)       Employee: David Chen

summary.summary_detailed:
EXECUTIVE EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT
This Executive Employment Agreement is made on March 1, 2026, between Apex Innovations Corp ("Company") and David Chen ("Employee").

Position and Scope of Duties
Company agrees to employ Employee as Chief Technology Officer (CTO).

Employee is eligible for standard health insurance and 401(k) benefits.

Confidentiality and Trade Secrets
Employee acknowledges that during employment, Employee will have access to proprietary trade secrets, customer databases, and software architectures.

Intellectual Property Assignment
Employee hereby assigns to Company all right, title, and interest in and to any and all inventions, patents, designs, copyrights, and software code conceived or created by Employee during the period of employment that relate to Company business.

Company may terminate Employee employment immediately for Cause in the event of gross negligence, fraud, or conviction of a felony.

Governing Law and Dispute Resolution
This Agreement shall be construed and governed in accordance with the laws of the State of California.
